response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A7.1", "A7.4"], "rationale": "The claim involves the loss of luggage during travel, and the insured has provided a Property Irregularity Report as required by clause A7.4. Clause A7.1 covers loss of luggage during transportation by a carrier, which applies here. There is no indication of any exclusionary factors such as intentional loss, alcohol, extreme sports, or war/terrorism (clauses A11.1–A11.4). The items listed (camera, mobile phone, laptop, suitcase, shoes) are not excluded under A7.6, as they are not cash, payment cards, travel documents, or valuables."}
